Title: Login with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Open account.proton.me/mail 2. Enter username and password 3. Click Sign in
Expected Result: Inbox page is displayed

Title: Login with wrong password (negative)
Steps: 1. Open login page 2. Enter valid username and wrong password 3. Click Sign in
Expected Result: Error message is shown and user stays on login page

Title: Login with empty username and password (validation)
Steps: 1. Leave both fields empty 2. Click Sign in
Expected Result: Required field validation is shown and no login happens

Title: Sign out
Steps: 1. Open profile menu 2. Click Sign out 3. Confirm
Expected Result: Sign in page is displayed

Title: Session stays after page refresh
Steps: 1. Login 2. Refresh the browser
Expected Result: Inbox is still displayed without asking for login

Title: Browser back after sign out does not show mailbox
Steps: 1. Sign out 2. Click browser back
Expected Result: Mailbox content is not shown and login page is displayed

Title: Repeated wrong passwords (rate limit / CAPTCHA)
Steps: 1. Enter wrong password many times
Expected Result: Account is protected (delay or CAPTCHA) - behaviour changes and can lock the test account

Title: 2FA and account recovery flows
Steps: 1. Login with 2FA code
Expected Result: Needs a separate account and a live OTP

Title: Send an email and verify in Sent
Steps: 1. Click New message 2. Enter recipient subject body 3. Click Send 4. Open Sent folder
Expected Result: 'Message sent.' toast is shown and mail is listed in Sent

Title: Send without recipient (negative)
Steps: 1. Open composer 2. Enter subject and body only 3. Click Send
Expected Result: Mail is not sent and composer stays open

Title: Send to invalid email address (negative)
Steps: 1. Open composer 2. Enter 'invalid-email' as recipient 3. Click Send
Expected Result: Mail is not sent and composer stays open

Title: Send with CC and BCC
Steps: 1. Add To CC and BCC 2. Send 3. Check each mailbox
Expected Result: CC visible to all and BCC hidden from others

Title: Send with empty subject
Steps: 1. Enter recipient and body only 2. Click Send
Expected Result: Proton asks for confirmation before sending

Title: Very long subject and body (boundary)
Steps: 1. Paste very long text 2. Send
Expected Result: Mail is sent or a clear limit message is shown

Title: Two account flow: sender sends and receiver receives
Steps: 1. Account 1 sends mail to account 2 2. Login to account 2 in second browser 3. Check inbox
Expected Result: Mail is received in account 2 inbox

Title: Draft is auto saved and can be reopened
Steps: 1. Open composer and fill details 2. Close composer 3. Open Drafts and open the draft
Expected Result: 'Draft saved.' toast and recipient subject body are same as typed

Title: Delete a draft
Steps: 1. Create a draft 2. Open it 3. Delete draft and confirm
Expected Result: Draft is removed from Drafts list

Title: Draft to sent transition
Steps: 1. Open draft 2. Click Send 3. Check Drafts and Sent
Expected Result: Draft moves from Drafts to Sent

Title: Draft is kept after browser refresh
Steps: 1. Wait for Draft saved 2. Refresh page 3. Open Drafts
Expected Result: Draft is still available

Title: Star a message
Steps: 1. Hover on mail 2. Click star 3. Open Starred
Expected Result: Mail is listed in Starred

Title: Archive a message
Steps: 1. Select mail 2. Click Archive 3. Open Archive
Expected Result: Mail leaves inbox and is listed in Archive

Title: Move a message to Trash
Steps: 1. Select mail 2. Click Move to trash 3. Open Trash
Expected Result: Mail leaves inbox and is listed in Trash

Title: Restore a message from Trash
Steps: 1. Select mail in Trash 2. Move to Inbox
Expected Result: Mail is back in inbox

Title: Mark read and unread
Steps: 1. Open mail 2. Mark as unread
Expected Result: Unread counter changes

Title: Bulk select and delete
Steps: 1. Select two mails 2. Move to trash 3. Open Trash
Expected Result: Both selected mails leave the inbox and are listed in Trash

Title: Apply label to a message
Preconditions: Label 'p' exists and mail in inbox
Steps: 1. Select mail 2. Label as 'p' 3. Open label
Expected Result: Mail is listed under the label

Title: Create and delete a folder
Steps: 1. Create folder 2. Move mail 3. Delete folder
Expected Result: Folder and mail state is correct

Title: Remove label from message
Steps: 1. Open Label as 2. Untick label 3. Apply
Expected Result: Mail is not listed under label

Title: Search by keyword
Steps: 1. Click search 2. Enter subject 3. Press Enter
Expected Result: Matching mail is listed

Title: Search with no result and clear (negative)
Steps: 1. Search random keyword 2. Click clear
Expected Result: 'No results found' is shown and goes away after clear

Title: Advanced search with keyword and sender (multi-condition)
Steps: 1. Open search 2. More options 3. Enter keyword and sender 4. Search
Test Data: Matching sender and a non matching sender
Expected Result: Match found for correct sender and no result for wrong sender

Title: Search with date range
Steps: 1. Advanced search 2. Select start and end date
Expected Result: Only mails in the range are listed (date picker is brittle)

Title: Search inside mail body (encrypted search)
Steps: 1. Enable content search 2. Search body word
Expected Result: Mail with body word is listed (needs indexing time)

Title: Create filter that stars matching mail
Steps: 1. Add filter with subject contains keyword and action star 2. Send mail with keyword 3. Open Starred
Expected Result: Matching mail is starred; filter is deleted after test

Title: Non matching mail is not affected by filter
Steps: 1. Send mail without keyword 2. Check Starred
Expected Result: Mail is not starred

Title: Disable filter (disabled filter does not act on matching mail)
Steps: 1. Disable filter 2. Send matching mail
Expected Result: Mail is not starred while disabled

Title: Attach and remove a file in composer
Steps: 1. Open composer 2. Attach sample.txt 3. Remove it
Expected Result: Attachment count is 1 then attachment is removed

Title: Send email with attachment
Steps: 1. Attach sample.txt 2. Send to own mailbox 3. Check inbox
Expected Result: Received mail shows attachment icon

Title: Download received attachment and check file name
Steps: 1. Open mail 2. Download file
Expected Result: Downloaded file name and content are same

Title: Draft keeps attachment
Steps: 1. Save draft 2. Reopen
Expected Result: Attachment is still there

Title: Attachment above size limit (boundary)
Steps: 1. Attach file bigger than 25 MB
Expected Result: Clear error is shown

Title: Undo send
Steps: 1. Send mail 2. Click Undo in toast 3. Check composer and Sent
Expected Result: Composer reopens with same subject and mail is not in Sent

Title: Scheduled send for Tomorrow: create, verify Scheduled state, cancel
Steps: 1. Compose mail to own address 2. Schedule for Tomorrow 3. Open Scheduled folder and the mail 4. Click Edit on the banner and Edit draft
Expected Result: Mail is listed in Scheduled with the banner "will be sent", after cancel it is a draft and the Scheduled folder is gone. Delivery at 08:00 stays a manual check.

Title: Password protected email
Steps: 1. Set password in composer 2. Send 3. Open from receiver
Expected Result: Receiver must enter password to read

Title: Login with multiple credentials from Excel (data driven)
Steps: 1. Read each row 2. Login with username and password 3. Check result
Test Data: 5 rows: 2 valid accounts and 3 invalid combinations
Expected Result: Inbox for 'success' rows and error message for 'error' rows

Title: CC and BCC recipients are kept in a saved draft
Steps: 1. Open composer 2. Enter To, CC and BCC 3. Close composer 4. Open the draft from Drafts 5. Delete the draft
Test Data: To = account 2, CC = own address, BCC = bcc.check@example.com
Expected Result: Three recipient fields show the entered addresses before and after reopening; nothing is sent
